summary: Hylaeus was a centaur who, with Rhoecus, assaulted Atalanta in Arcadia and was slain by her arrows. Apollodorus is the primary source for the episode in Atalanta's virgin-huntress life before the Calydonian boar.

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: Apollodorus pairs Hylaeus with Rhoecus as centaurs killed by Atalanta when they tried to violate her.
Not to be confused with unrelated bearers of the name in Ovid's hunting catalogues.
